rule.protocol: SWA: fixed number of epochs, weights averaged over the last epochs; no epoch selection on validation

test_time_options.center: subject-wise score centring: log-probabilities minus the subject's mean per class (label-free, uses only the subject's own recordings)

rule.validation_metric: recording-level balanced accuracy over the 4 validation subjects of each fold, AdaBN applied per validation subject (as on the test subject)
rule.selection_rule: v4 = the 'v4 candidate' with the highest mean over the two datasets of the fold-mean validation balanced accuracy (seed 0, test-time option chosen per dataset by validation). Ties -> the simpler candidate (fewer extra terms). The baseline chooses its own test-time option per dataset by validation in the same way.

tests.H-V4: v4 (3-seed ensemble) > EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] (3-seed ensemble), one-sided Wilcoxon over held-out subjects, Holm over the 2 datasets, alpha 0.05
tests.H-V4-prev: v4 (3-seed ensemble) > the best pre-registered model of the FINAL run (EEGNet + EA + AdaBN, 3-seed ensemble, early stopping), one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the 2 datasets
tests.best-model rule: v4 is called 'best' on a dataset only if its fold-mean is the highest of all models in the final benchmark AND H-V4-prev is met there

rule.status: post-hoc, validation-selected, exploratory (designed after the pre-registered results were known)
